proposal.description: The duty snapshot is assumed never to exceed the nominal period (111 < 128), so the drift-headroom MSB of period_counter is dropped from duty_count and the high-phase length is exported modulo 2^(CNT_W-1).
proposal.reason: When a stalled-high PWM finally falls with the counter saturated, duty_count reads 127 instead of the all-ones out-of-range marker 255. The same happens for any high phase of 129 or more clocks: duty_count reads short.

proposal.description: The out-of-range marker is made sticky: a rising edge that ends a saturated period captures all-ones into prev_period but does not restart period_counter, so the counter stays saturated until reset.
proposal.reason: After one stall (pwm_sync held high or low until period_counter reaches 255), the PWM can resume normally. prev_period then reads 255 at every later rising edge, and duty_count reads 255 at every later falling edge, until rst_n is asserted. It should show the real period and duty again.
